description: Calls GET /v1/index on the Receipts API. Free. Returns row ids and UTC dates (no row content), the row count, the first and last dates, and the list of dates that have rows. Use start and limit to page through row ids. Row content is sold per call through x402 and is not returned here.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 500. The API default applies when omitted.

start.description: First row id of the page. Default 1.

name: receipts_index
title: Receipts Index: free row index
